statementMode.title: Statement layout

packages.hydroHint: Export a standalone Hydro ZIP with problem.yaml, multilingual statements, samples, test data and configuration, programs and attachments.

packages.wholeHint: Import statements, data and programs. Extra files appear under Other files.

oiFeatures.convertCheckerHint: Converts basic testlib includes and initialization, preserving the original. quitp keeps proportional scoring; complex scoring APIs need manual conversion.
oiFeatures.lemonCheckerHint: LemonLime only; uses the Testlib for Lemons protocol.
oiFeatures.preparingDown: Generating samples and updating the OI statement…

oiFeatures.subtaskHint: Bundled: all tests must pass. Dependencies: all prerequisite subtasks and their dependencies must pass, regardless of list order. Set each subtask's score freely.
oiFeatures.exportHint: Exports the default tests testset, generating inputs and answers. The ZIP contains a contest .cdf, data/, and an empty source/. Batch and grader problems are supported; pipe-based I/O interaction is not. Checker executables target the current operating system.
oiFeatures.fractional: Subtask {name} has fractional points; Polygon only supports integer test points.
